description: This file contains the static class 'SerializerConfigurationAnalyzer' which provides functionality to analyze serializer configuration for potential issues within Orleans serialization framework. It inspects interface methods for types that may lack proper serializers or copiers, and reports types with serializability problems.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationAnalyzer
classes.description: A static class providing methods to analyze serializer availability and identify configuration issues related to types used in interface methods.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationComplaint
classes.description: Represents a specific complaint about the serializability of a type, including whether a serializer and copier are available, and which interface methods reference this type.

methods.name: AnalyzeSerializerAvailability
methods.description: Analyzes interface methods within the provided options to identify types that lack necessary serializers or copiers, returning a dictionary of such types with associated complaints.
